messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The loan approval process starts by receiving a customer request for a loan amount. The risk assessment Web service is invoked to assess the request. If the loan is small and the customer is low risk, the loan is approved. If the customer is high risk, the loan is denied. If the customer needs further review or the loan amount is for $10,000 or more, the request is sent to the approver Web service. The customer receives feedback from the assessor or approver.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="LoanApprovalProcess" name="Loan Approval Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive Customer Request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RiskAssessment" name="Invoke Risk Assessment Web Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Decision Gateway" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approve</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deny</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FurtherReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Loan Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approve</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Denied" name="Loan Denied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deny</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproverService" name="Send to Approver Web Service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FurtherReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Feedback" name="Customer Receives Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_RiskAssessment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_RiskAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approve" name="Small Loan & Low Risk" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loanAmount < 10000 AND riskLevel == 'LOW'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny" name="High Risk" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Denied">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">riskLevel == 'HIGH'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherReview" name="Further Review or Large Amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_ApproverService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">riskLevel == 'MEDIUM' OR loanAmount >= 10000</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalFeedback" sourceRef="Task_ApproverService" targetRef="EndEvent_Feedback" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
